# 2 Peter

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

2 Peter urges believers to pursue spiritual maturity, reject false teaching, and live in anticipation of Christ's return.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">2 Peter 1:21</div>

<div class="identifier">Holy men of God spake as moved by the Holy Ghost</div>

### Why This Verse

Inspiration of Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages spiritual growth and confidence in God's promises. The key verse emphasizes diligently developing godly character as evidence of a fruitful faith.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">2 Peter 2:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lord knows how to deliver the godly</div>

### Why This Verse

Preservation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter warns against false teachers and their destructive influence. The key verse highlights God's certainty in judging wickedness while preserving the righteous.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">2 Peter 3:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The Lord is not willing that any should perish</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted verses in the epistle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses Christ's return and the coming judgment. The key verse explains that God's apparent delay is an expression of patience, giving people opportunity to repent.
:::
